title: Signal Station
author: Luke Steuber
description:
I wanted a small field notebook for moments worth keeping. Press Up on your Pebble to capture the readings you choose, Select to ask a question, or Down to revisit recent history. The phone keeps the full records. Capture needs no provider key; analyze a saved capture when you want a text reply.

Use the Signal Station Android companion for setup, permissions, watch installation and your own provider keys. Location, weather, nearby signals, phone sensors and supported watch health readings are individually optional. There is no ambient audio or video collection.

By Luke Steuber.
releaseNotes: Up captures selected readings without a provider key. Select asks a question. Down opens recent phone history. New menu and launcher icons, plus clearer return and cancel controls. Use Signal Station Android companion lab 4 for guided setup, permissions, bundled watch installation, local capture and later analysis.
